terminals.name: admin-web
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd apps/admin_web && npm run dev

terminals.name: public-www
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && cd apps/public_www && NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3100 NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_NAME="Siu Tin Dei" NEXT_PUBLIC_STAGING_SEARCH_DATA_ENABLED=true npm run dev -- -p 3100
